Solo comparamos tres ventanas fijas de d: We compare only three fixed windows from two Earth regions, at a regional scale of 10 km. Lower distance means greater similarity in the analyzed variables; it is not a percentage, probability or suitability for building a base.
Ambos recortes usan celdas de 500 m y el: Both subsets use 500 m cells and the same physical extent. MOLA has approximately 463 m pixels at the equator; the Earth mosaic uses different instruments and resolution. Aggregating to a common cell does not equalize effective resolution. Each window mean is removed to compare terrain variation rather than absolute planetary elevations. The vertical control only changes the visualization.
Tres ventanas prefijadas de dos regiones: Three predefined windows from two regions. Ranking depends on seven descriptors; these are not the three best locations on Earth.
PCA resume las siete variables del relie: PCA summarizes seven terrain variables into patterns learned from Earth windows. A smaller distance to Jezero indicates greater similarity in that summary.
La varianza explicada describe cuánto co: Explained variance describes how much variation the summary retains, not scientific accuracy. Agreement with the baseline does not demonstrate improvement. There are only two independent regions and neighboring windows retain autocorrelation. Internal evaluation does not validate geological equivalence or suitability for building a base.

Prototipo académico para NASA Space Apps: Academic prototype for NASA Space Apps. Challenge: “Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars”. Current scope: Mars and Earth candidates for exploring potential test sites.
Ventanas terrestres prefijadas frente a: Predefined Earth windows compared with Jezero. The ranking compares terrain patterns; it is not a global selection or scientific certification.
Cada ventana mide 10 × 10 km y usa celda: Each window measures 10 · 10 km and uses 500 m cells. La Joya and Atacama are two source regions; the two Atacama candidates do not constitute two independent training regions.
PCA resume siete variables: relieve robu: PCA summarizes seven variables: robust relief, elevation spread, mean slope, P90 slope, slope spread and two roughness measures. It learns combinations of these variables from Earth training windows. Distance in this summary ranks descriptive similarity to Jezero.
La comparación base utiliza las siete va: The baseline uses all seven standardized variables without compression. Distances are dimensionless, not percentages or probabilities. Each subset is centered on its own mean; absolute elevations are not compared across planets.
La varianza explicada describe cuánta va: Explained variance describes how much variation the summary retains, not scientific accuracy. Agreement with the baseline does not demonstrate improvement. Training and evaluation windows are separated by a spatial buffer but may retain autocorrelation. There are only two independent Earth regions.
No hay etiquetas expertas ni validación: There are no expert labels or external validation. Scientific accuracy has not been calculated. This evaluation does not demonstrate geological equivalence, suitability for building a base or safe rover routes.
